correctness.rationale: An unambiguous order-ideal encoding is enumerated independently by bounded six-height arrays and by saturated Hasse-cover BFS, yielding identical 490 masks. Exact 24-stage Walsh transforms in opposite stage orders agree on all 2^24 coordinates; direct defining signed sums agree on 8192 characters; complete Parseval, mean, and sign-pairing checks pass. The support-indicator transform is independently double-checked and its exact L1 sum is 11,078,918,348. Translation averaging proves minimality among arbitrary real or complex projections. The actual standalone code and complete spectral/support-kernel tables are in the new package, and the check is reproducible.

value.rationale: The 2×3×4 box is the smallest true three-dimensional box with all three side lengths distinct and at least two, a canonical first asymmetric lozenge-tiling ensemble. Complete Fourier nullity, multiplier extremes, and the sharp unrestricted endpoint projection constant quantify exact information loss and worst-case recovery amplification not implied by the 490 count. Their precise values provide a natural finite benchmark for harmonic analysis on constrained tiling incidence sets; no sweeping general theorem is needed for this motivated finite classification.
